tests.name: Rig: Select a hidden sector outside known adjacent exits

data.sql: SELECT s.sector_id FROM sectors s WHERE s.sector_id<>1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sector_warps w WHERE w.from_sector=1 AND w.to_sector=s.sector_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM player_visited_sectors v WHERE v.player_id=@{mover_pathfind_player_id} AND v.sector_id=s.sector_id) ORDER BY s.sector_id LIMIT 1;
